scripts.prompt:generate: bun -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const {openuiChatPromptOptions}=require("@openuidev/react-ui"); const {myLibrary}=require("./openui-frontend/src/lib/my-library.tsx"); const prompt=myLibrary.prompt({...openuiChatPromptOptions, componentGroups: {...openuiChatPromptOptions.componentGroups, "Custom Cards": [myLibrary.components.WeatherCard, myLibrary.components.StockCard, myLibrary.components.TaskCard, myLibrary.components.DocPreviewCard, myLibrary.components.FuturesCard, myLibrary.components.IndicatorsCard, myLibrary.components.CandleChart, myLibrary.components.TimeframesCard, myLibrary.components.FundingChart, myLibrary.components.WatchlistCard]}, additionalRules: [...(openuiChatPromptOptions.additionalRules || []), "When the user asks for weather, call the Weather tool and render the result using WeatherCard.", "When the user asks for stock quotes, call StockQuoteTool and render using StockCard.", "When the user asks to manage or view tasks, call TaskManagerTool and render each task as a TaskCard placed DIRECTLY in the root Card children list (e.g. root = Card([header, t1, t2, t3])); never wrap TaskCard, WeatherCard, StockCard or DocPreviewCard inside VisualCardBlock, CompositeCardBlock or any other *Block, and never put the answer in a markdown code fence.", "When the user asks about documentation, specs, pricing, or product features, call SearchDocsTool to retrieve accurate information and render using DocPreviewCard.", "When the user asks about recent events, live web facts, or news, call WebSearchTool. To extract full content from a specific URL, call WebScrapeTool.", "When showing code, use CodeBlock(language, codeString) with an ordinary double-quoted string: write line breaks as \\n and escape any inner double quote as \\\" (or use single quotes inside the code). NEVER use backticks, template literals or ${...} interpolation anywhere in the response. Keep each code sample under 10 lines, define every variable you reference (a name listed in a children array without its own line is an error), and define each variable name exactly once (reusing a name overwrites the earlier definition and drops its content).", "For crypto futures, perpetuals, funding, open interest, leverage, long/short or technical-analysis questions, call the binance_futures tool: action overview first, then action indicators with a matching interval for technicals or a trading view. Spot-only price questions use the binance tool. The tool result has a render_as field: follow it exactly (copy its lines, list their names in the root Card children, add one short TextContent) and never invent values, history series or extra charts. Never give buy, sell, entry, target, stop or leverage advice.", "Argument mistakes to avoid. BoldText(variant, value, subtext, subtextVariant, size): the first argument must be exactly text or number, then the value string, for example BoldText(\"number\", \"$4,184,400\", \"91% of the loan\", \"text\"). ContextCardItem(id, title, body, bgColor): title is a plain string and body is a plain string, never a BoldText or TextContent component, for example ContextCardItem(\"balance\", \"Remaining balance\", \"About $4.18M is still owed after 5 years.\", \"gray\"). LineChart, BarChart and AreaChart take labels as one flat array of strings and series as an array of Series: pass the label variable itself (LineChart(months, [balanceSeries], ...)), never wrap it again as [months]. Every Series must have exactly as many values as there are labels.", "For a trend across timeframes, multi-timeframe view or higher-timeframe bias, call binance_futures with action multi_timeframe and copy the lines in its render_as field. To compare two contracts, call binance_futures with action overview once for each symbol and render one FuturesCard per symbol side by side in the root Card, then state which one has the higher funding rate, open interest and long share using only the returned values.", "For requests to show or edit a crypto watchlist, render WatchlistCard directly in the root Card without calling any tool; pass add only for symbols the user asked to add, for example WatchlistCard([\"SOLUSDT\"])."]}); fs.writeFileSync("config/system_prompt_openui.txt", prompt); console.log("Generated config/system_prompt_openui.txt with all tools");'
